scope.application_paper_rule: Admit only an explicitly documented MAS data-management/preparation/analysis support component. Keep demo designs, research evaluation and visions distinct; do not demand a general-purpose system or a standalone component benchmark as an unstated inclusion gate.
scope.unknown_evidence_rule: Not admitted; do not describe missing evidence as proof of irrelevance.
scope.conference_year_rule: Publication years define window. Conference cycle is retained separately; NOMA is a 2026 publication in VLDB 2027 cycle.

method.repository_scan: Read README snapshots, extract linked candidate entries, match normalized titles and approved aliases to existing records and cached conference metadata; inspect primary sources for likely/boundary cases. Not an exhaustive publication lookup for every unannotated preprint.
method.review_depth: Included entries require selected fulltext mechanism evidence. Other entries may have only metadata, abstract or prior screening. A strict whitelist, not 691 completed full-paper reviews.

10.1145/3802046.evidence_location: Author extended version arXiv:2603.16104v1, Figure 2, §§2–5 and §7.1, pp3–7
10.1145/3802046.evidence_en: Helium evaluates collaborating expert/summarizer, multi-agent debate, and expert/critic reflection workflows. Section 4 applies dead-code pruning, identical-subgraph elimination, and deterministic cached-result substitution to their logical DAGs.
10.1145/3802046.limitation_en: The overall system remains in Execution. Section 4 is relevant to Planning, but assumes a supplied DAG and does not demonstrate general task or role extraction. Reuse requires compatible inputs and deterministic behavior; semantic similarity alone is insufficient.
10.1145/3802046.reason_zh: 全文明确评测协作 MAS，并用查询计划改写和调度降低工作流开销。

10.14778/3750601.3750611.evidence_en: SagaLLM coordinates task agents with a validation agent and Saga coordinator. Persistent state, dependency records, validation and compensating operations support workflow recovery. Algorithm 1 constructs task roles and dependencies.
10.14778/3750601.3750611.limitation_en: The primary contribution is recovery and validation. Algorithm 1 is a relevant construction mechanism, not an independently evaluated general-purpose role/dependency extractor; no universal ACID guarantee for arbitrary external APIs.
10.14778/3750601.3750611.reason_zh: 明确协作 MAS，以状态记录、验证和 Saga 补偿支持协作正确性。

10.14778/3845598.3845602.evidence_en: NOMA explicitly proposes database-style optimization of multi-agent topology, model choices, and execution engines, with cost, latency and quality objectives.
10.14778/3845598.3845602.limitation_en: A dedicated MAS vision with motivating experiments, not a completed integrated optimizer. Published in 2026 but belongs to the VLDB 2027 cycle. The existing agent registry is not evidence of automatic role extraction.
10.14778/3845598.3845602.reason_zh: 直接以 MAS 工作流为优化对象；保留为 vision，不能当作已实现优化器。

https://www.vldb.org/cidrdb/2026/support.evidence_en: The paper considers an agent in charge and field agents, and proposes pruning redundant probes and sharing work across agents and turns using their goals, phase and accuracy requirements.
https://www.vldb.org/cidrdb/2026/support.limitation_en: CIDR is a separately identified DB conference extension. The paper mixes single-agent and multi-agent motivating cases; the proposed MAS-aware optimizer is a vision. Its MAS-specific work-selection discussion is the retained contribution.
https://www.vldb.org/cidrdb/2026/support.reason_zh: 明确提出跨 agent 共享与裁剪探测请求；以 CIDR 扩展及 vision 标识。

10.1109/icde65448.2025.00326.evidence_en: DataLab has a proxy and specialized collaborating BI agents. 10.1109/icde65448.2025.00326.limitation_en: Retained only for its explicitly evaluated inter-agent data-management component, not because BI is a database task. Notebook-cell dependency extraction in §VI supports context retrieval; it is not extraction of a future collaboration plan. Primary layer: Execution, not Planning.

10.14778/3685800.3685876.reason_zh: 仅纳入已定位的 MAS 协作支撑机制：Workflow Management；应用功能本身不是纳入依据。

10.1145/3788853.3801612.reason_zh: 仅纳入已定位的 MAS 协作支撑机制：Workflow Optimization；应用功能本身不是纳入依据。

10.14778/3675034.3675043.reason_zh: 仅纳入已定位的 MAS 协作支撑机制：Communication Optimization；应用功能本身不是纳入依据。

10.14778/3778092.3778093.reason_zh: 仅纳入已定位的 MAS 协作支撑机制：Agent Scheduling；应用功能本身不是纳入依据。

seed_inventory_decisions.title: SagaLLM: Context Management, Validation, and Transaction Guarantees for Multi-Agent LLM Planning
seed_inventory_decisions.evidence_en: SagaLLM coordinates task agents with a validation agent and Saga coordinator. Persistent state, dependency records, validation and compensating operations support workflow recovery. Algorithm 1 constructs task roles and dependencies.
seed_inventory_decisions.limitation_en: The primary contribution is recovery and validation. Algorithm 1 is a relevant construction mechanism, not an independently evaluated general-purpose role/dependency extractor; no universal ACID guarantee for arbitrary external APIs.
seed_inventory_decisions.reason_zh: 明确协作 MAS，以状态记录、验证和 Saga 补偿支持协作正确性。
